senses.def: A former oblast of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic, established in August 1940, annexed to Odesa Oblast in February 1954.
A former miskrada of Odesa Oblast, Ukraine, superseded by Izmail urban hromada in June 2020; administrative centre and sole constituent settlement: Izmail.
A raion of Odesa Oblast, Ukraine, established in November 1940, considerably enlarged in July 2020.

A specialized surgical knife used by the mohel in the Jewish circumcision ritual of Brit Milah for infant males. It must have certain characteristics, per Jewish Law, including that it may not stop the flow of blood (unlike the constricting devices commonly used by a surgeon or Urologist).
An aporphinebenzylisoquinoline alkaloid first isolated from Thalictrum przewalskii.
